proposition: One ijāza by Ibn Turka survives: a certificate for his K. al-Maṣābīḥ (Arabic), given to an unnamed prominent contemporary, in MS Majlis 10196 f. 126a.

mediation.note: The recipient is not named on the page read.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
